q1.sampleAnswer:
Dear Mr Burton
I think it is a great idea to have some extra activities on Healthy Living Day because it is very important to educate students about healthy way of life.
I personally think we should make a video about how it is important to exercise every day, because it is very importnant for our health.
I am very good with the camera so I think I could help you with that, and students you pick can gather some information about types of exercises.
Sorry, but this Tuesday is not convenient for me, maybe some other day if you are free.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①说明自己觉得办健康生活日是个好主意（Good idea!）；②说明拍健康饮食还是运动锻炼的视频更好，并解释原因（Explain）；③告诉 Burton 老师自己能怎样帮忙，如查资料、拍摄或当主持人（Tell Mr Burton）；④道歉并说明为什么周二放学后不能参加会议（Sorry, but…）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：表示这是个好主意、说明选哪个视频主题并给出理由、说清自己能帮什么忙、礼貌地道歉并说明不能参会的原因；写给老师要用礼貌、得体的语气，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer:
In the future the education must change, but in a different way that it is not links with the subjects.
In fact I think that the young people always need to go to school. There they will learn to stay with the others, to know different people and different kind of cultures. Staying at home, and made lessons online will not help them to grow up.
About the subjects I hope that the school programmes will change. The new generation need more social coaching, for example leadership or cooperation work, and moreover more technical subjects that teach them how take care of the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：文章回答公告中的问题：①将来的教育会有什么不同，例如学生是去学校上学还是在家上网课；②学生会不会学和现在一样的科目，为什么

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要回答公告中的全部问题（将来的教育怎样变化、上学还是网课、科目会不会变及原因），给出清楚的观点和理由；有吸引读者的开头和结尾，分段清楚，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer:
He was finally 18 years old, and he wanted to have an amazing birthday party.
He was nervous because he is very shy, but that night he just wanted to have fun and have a good time with all his friends.
But, when he arrived, there was no one there.
He couldn’t believe: his friends didn’t go to his party!
That was terrible and, soon, Marc felt so sad that he started to cry and he hoped that it was just a scary nightmare.
At that moment, he understood. He was so nervous that he was arrived 2 hours before the start of the party!

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（As Marc got out of the car, he started to feel both excited and nervous.），情节说明 Marc 为什么既兴奋又紧张，内容完整，有清楚的结局
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。作者没有抄写开头句，而是直接接着往下写，这种做法也可以接受，内容全部切题，并与给定句子在逻辑上衔接；成功运用讲故事的手法，开头、经过、结尾清楚，并让读者一直了解人物的想法（he wanted to have an amazing birthday party; He couldn’t believe）；句子顺序合乎逻辑，用 that night, At that moment 等衔接，六个很短的段落增加了戏剧感；词汇恰当，能表现人物性格和感受（shy; scary nightmare），句式有变化，用了 Marc felt so sad that he started to cry 等较高级的结构，只有少量小错误，不影响理解。
